senses.gloss:
कौरव कौरव, i. e. कुरु + अ, adj., f. वी
 1. Belonging to the Kurus, Megh. 49; consisting of Kurus, MBh. 1, 5457.
 2. patron. A descendant of Kuru, Nal. 14, 26; MBh. 1, 5457.
 --Comp.
 When latter part of an adj. the fem. ends in वा, निष्कौरव, i. e. निस्-, adj., f. वा, deprived of Kauravas, MBh. 1, 7961.
कौरवेय कौरवेय, i. e. कुरु + एय, patron. A descendant of Kuru, MBh. 1, 5689.

कौरव्य कौरव्य, i. e. कुरु + य,
 I. m.
 1. A descendant of Kuru, MBh. 14, 2521.
 2. The name of a Nāga or serpent, MBh. 1, 5558.
 II. adj. Belonging to the Kurus, MBh. 14, 2484.
कौर्म कौर्म, i. e. कूर्म + अ, adj. Peculiar to a tortoise, Pañc. iii. d. 20.
